hooks.command: out=$(npm test 2>&1); pass=$(printf '%s' "$out" | grep -m1 '^# pass' | grep -o '[0-9]*'); fail=$(printf '%s' "$out" | grep -m1 '^# fail' | grep -o '[0-9]*'); if [ "$fail" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then printf '{"systemMessage": "\u26a0 npm test: %s passed, %s failed \u2014 check before pushing"}' "$pass" "$fail"; else printf '{"systemMessage": "\u2713 npm test: %s passed"}' "$pass"; fi

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.js) out=$(node --check "$f" 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -eq 0 ]; then printf '{"systemMessage": "✓ Syntax OK: %s"}' "$f"; else esc=$(printf '%s' "$out" | jq -Rs .); printf '{"systemMessage": "✗ Syntax error in %s", "decision": "block", "reason": %s}' "$f" "$esc"; fi;; esac; }
